about: Dated releases and deadlines for admin/data-releases.ics. Build the calendar with: python _python/local/release-calendar.py. status is confirmed (date published by the source), expected (usual timing, check the release calendar) or deadline (a draft that needs refreshing). Give an event a fixed "id" before changing its date or title, so re-importing updates it rather than adding a copy. Checked 2026-10-08.

events.title: ONS private rents (September data)
events.notes: Feeds /cheltenham-rent-prices through rents.py in the monthly workflow, which next runs on 2 November. Run the monthly workflow by hand to show it sooner.

events.title: ONS employee earnings (ASHE 2026)
events.notes: Feeds /cheltenham-earnings-history and /cheltenham-house-prices/affordability through earnings.py and affordability.py in the monthly workflow. Nomis loads the new year a week or two after the ONS release, so the monthly workflow only picks it up once Nomis has it.

events.title: NHS A&E figures (October data)
events.notes: Run by hand on 2026-11-13 after the workflow missed it again. The 2026-10-09 analysis post was updated with October's 12-hour waits; no follow-up post, A&E is reviewed month by month.

events.title: Check: Ofcom Connected Nations 2026 report
events.notes: Not confirmed. The 2025 report came out on 19 November 2025. Manual: save the new coverage CSVs, then run process-mobile-coverage.py and process-wardband.py.

events.title: ONS private rents (October data)
events.notes: Feeds /cheltenham-rent-prices through rents.py in the monthly workflow, which next runs on 2 December.

events.title: MHCLG housing supply (net additional dwellings 2025-26)
events.notes: Confirmed for 26 November 2026 at 09:30 on GOV.UK. Feeds /cheltenham-house-prices/housing-supply through housing-supply.py in the monthly workflow, which next runs on 2 December. Run the monthly workflow by hand on the day to show it sooner.

events.title: NHS A&E figures (November data)
events.notes: pi/nhs-ae.py checks hourly on the Raspberry Pi, so this should land on the day. If the month is still missing the day after release, the script fails and the watchdog emails about it.

events.title: NHS A&E figures (December data)
events.notes: pi/nhs-ae.py checks hourly on the Raspberry Pi, so this should land on the day. If the month is still missing the day after release, the script fails and the watchdog emails about it.

events.title: NHS A&E figures (January data)
events.notes: pi/nhs-ae.py checks hourly on the Raspberry Pi, so this should land on the day. If the month is still missing the day after release, the script fails and the watchdog emails about it. January is the winter peak, the month the A&E analysis compares year on year.

events.title: Check: DfE pupil absence full year 2025/26 date
events.notes: Provisional for March 2027 (the 2024/25 figures came out on 26 March 2026, 2023/24 on 20 March 2025). Feeds the pupil absence section of /cheltenham-schools through school-absence.py in the monthly workflow, which picks up the new files on the next 2nd of the month. Run the monthly workflow by hand after release to show it sooner.

events.title: NHS A&E figures (February data)
events.notes: pi/nhs-ae.py checks hourly on the Raspberry Pi, so this should land on the day. If the month is still missing the day after release, the script fails and the watchdog emails about it. This is the last date in NHS England's current 12-month plan: add the next dates from https://www.england.nhs.uk/statistics/12-months-statistics-calendar/

events.title: Check: DfT road casualties provisional 2026 results
events.notes: Announced for May 2027 (provisional). Provisional figures only; the site uses the final results in July.

events.title: Check: Ofcom Connected Nations spring update
events.notes: Usually early May (13 May in 2026). Manual: save the new coverage CSVs, then run process-mobile-coverage.py and process-wardband.py.

events.title: Check: DfT road casualties final 2026 results
events.notes: Announced for July 2027 (provisional); 2025 results came out on 30 July 2026. Manual: download the last-5-years collision, casualty and vehicle CSVs into _data-sources/, then run process-road-collisions.py.

events.title: Check: MHCLG fire statistics incident level datasets
events.notes: Usually late July (22 July in 2026). Manual: download the outdoor fires dataset .ods files into _data-sources/outdoor-fires/, replacing the old ones, then run process-wildfire-incidents.py.

events.title: Check: DfE pupil absence autumn term 2026/27
events.notes: Provisional for August 2027. Autumn-term-only figures are not shown on the site, so nothing to run; useful as an early sign before the October release.

events.title: Check: DfE pupil absence autumn and spring 2026/27
events.notes: Provisional for October 2027 (15 October in 2026). Feeds the autumn and spring figures on /cheltenham-schools through school-absence.py in the monthly workflow.
